rows.definition: NativeSessionLifecycle is the modelengine enum type that labels whether a scheduler-created model session is fresh or restored so profiling and receipts can distinguish its construction path.
rows.distinction: It records model-session construction origin, not the cache-value SessionType workload-reporting tag and not mutable runtime session state.

rows.definition: NativeSessionRestored is the NativeSessionLifecycle value assigned when the scheduler rebuilds a model session during swap readmission and imports the preserved KV state.
rows.distinction: It identifies the restored member of the lifecycle enum, not the NativeSessionLifecycle type itself and not a fresh or recomputed session.

rows.definition: The closed promotion-candidate taxonomy a scratchpad artifact is classified into: unfinished-spine, blocked, discovered-edge-case, deferred-caveat, next-checkable-step. A CandidateKind is the deterministic Classify verdict over one parked artifact's filename/leading block.
rows.distinction: It is the CLOSED taxonomy value for a parked scratchpad artifact that looks like an unfiled session flag, NOT the plan/spawn Candidate (a scored span the planner may keep resident) and NOT a generic kind enum.

rows.definition: The per-launch random credential written into the guarded child's MCP HTTP config and hash-validated by the gateway to prove that an MCP request came from that launched child; it grants no workspace lease ownership.
rows.distinction: It proves guard-child launch provenance for MCP requests; it is not the gateway RequireKey/defaultGatewayBearerToken traffic credential and not the stored SHA-256 digest.
